law_record.title: Required position and method of turning at intersections (1)
law_record.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a right turn, both the approach for the right turn and the right turn must be made from the right turn lane if the highway has a right turn lane as set forth in subsection 4 of NRS 484B.223 [NRS-484B-223-4a, NRS-484B-223-4b], or must be made from the extreme right lane.

activation_conditions: the subject intends to turn right at an intersection
residue: 'intends to turn' is interior state; the completed turn is the observable substitute
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: both the approach and the turn must be from the required lane — the lane occupancy is tracked over the whole manoeuvre
intention is shown by the turn that follows, so the trace must cover the approach and the turn
